parameter_status: explicit integrated teaching configuration; actual result not prefilled

map.raster_rule: closed 1m square intersects radius+buffer disk => forbidden node; touching forbidden
map.execution_safety_rule: entire closed segment must stay in bounds and avoid all forbidden closed squares

task_generation.method: fixed first two; local Python Random(seed).sample from x-then-y sorted safe unique pool; explicit coordinates saved

coverage_rule: all known tasks counted; each completed once; historical accepted task IDs per UUV <=6; no refund

communication.rule: direct USV-UUC horizontal distance <= radius; ignore depth; no multihop
communication.role: evaluation only; no communication hard constraint or loss-triggered UUC hold
communication.sampling: left endpoint t represents [t,t+1); all five completed/failed/active UUC observed; denominator=600 boat-seconds; t120 terminal only

energy.scope: actual movement only; no stationary service/wait/communication/sensor/depth consumption
energy.rule: check before move; equality allowed; whole step rejection, failed boat holds to cutoff; no borrowing

scheduling.initial: Pyomo sum start-to-task A* cost; nearest-neighbor visit order; full route budget preflight separately
scheduling.response: retain healthy queues/protected service; append eligible observed new/orphan tasks by shortest safe tail route, lifetime capacity and complete remaining route budget

relay.tie_break: longest current outage age, nearest distance, boat ID
relay.information: ideal current true UUC states including failed holds
relay.motion: speed-limited straight candidate; unsafe candidate holds; no USV detour optimization

warmup.note: same map/speeds/service/energy/radius/seed; warmup communication denominator uses one UUC; integration code pending

event_information: events observed only at time_s; planning receives known task/state subset, never future events or future flow table
fault_policy: exit task work, unfinished service reset, receiver restarts full2s; ideal compensated hold retained

configuration_preparation.reason: actual t11 U1 service progress1; t24 U4 service progress1; observe protection/reset in one real case
configuration_preparation.actual_pilot_record: 输出文件/说明文档/P4统一案例准备_V01.json

x1.main_distance_scope: all six boats over [0,120), including USV relay after task completion
x1.changes: adjacency and required cost/heuristic wiring; each group own initial assignment/order; same dynamic rule
x1.frozen_events: arrival T21/T22 at11; U4 failure at24; no tuning after result

x2.initial_assignment_policy: Reuse frozen accepted X1-L4 eight-neighbor initial assignment and queues; no new solve
x2.map_update_policy: Observe before planning/movement at event time; only current blocked cells reach planner. Graph versions 0,1,2; no future events or flows in planning input.
x2.map_update_geometry: Closed 1m temporary forbidden square, positive geometric edges unchanged; t6 block then t18 clear (12,3).
x2.update_occupancy_precondition: All six starting points have distance to the closed updated square > 6*(1+0.2)m. Update does not newly occupy any boat under shared speed/current bound.
x2.main_distance_scope: All six boats actual movement in [0,120), including pre-fault movement and post-completion relay.
x2.search_work_definition: Effective non-stale pops including goal; unique nodes/pops/pushes/edge checks also saved.
x2.interface: SearchSession(start_grid, goal_grid, current_physical_config, current_blocked) -> safe shortest grid path or None; same continuous connector and rebuild; graph observation and time context explicit.
